thesis: A high-return, deleveraging private-markets manager with recurring fees trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF and well below peers on P/E, where the price implies modest growth.
reason: The fall is market and credit driven, not a broken business: last-12-month margins rose, leverage fell and multiples sit below their own 5-year lows. Scorecard conviction 4, standard core size set by Python; cash is at the floor, so it replaces CI, a below-bar conviction-3 holding.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, well under the 30.4% now, showing fee and carry economics have weakened structurally.
TTM operating margin falls below 42%, under the FY2023 level of 47.7%, showing fee-related earnings compression rather than carry timing.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 2.0x from 1.15x, reversing the deleveraging.
Shares change YoY exceeds 5%, showing dilution.

replacement_reason: Cash is at the 1.5% floor, so the buy needs funding; CI is held at conviction 3, below the buy bar, while CVC scores 4 with higher returns, lower leverage and multiples below their own 5-year minimums.
